notes: Card: ' students' x8, ' customers', ' readers', ' guests', ' Your', all as 'your X' addressed to a teacher, business or writer. Probe: 0.28-0.54 on 'your customers/students/readers/guests', 0.07 on 'your kitchen'. Near misses keep 'your' with a non-audience noun.
